summary: Iteration 14 — Frontend-only comprehensive audit of all major buttons and pages after the Statistics.js useLanguage import fix. ALL critical flows verified end-to-end on preview env (https://ai-functions-core.preview.emergentagent.com). The previously-blank Statistics page now renders fully with heading + 4 stat cards + Weekly Activity bar chart + Quick Stats panel — no console ReferenceError. Sidebar navigation for both regular user and admin works for every link. Tasks/Reminders modals open and Task creation persists. Profile shows language switcher (English/العربية), theme toggle (Dark/Light), and Thawani-related copy. Logout returns user to /login. Admin panel renders all 7 tabs; Plan filter buttons (all/free/pro/business) clickable; Change Subscription button shows after selecting a user row, opens a modal with Free/Pro/Business + Monthly/Yearly selectors + Apply Change button. Admin Audit Logs table renders 3 rows including subscription_change entries with 'Pro→Free / Free→Pro (yearly)' format and target email visible.
passed_tests: Statistics page renders (Statistics / Weekly Activity / Quick Stats headings, 4 stat cards, body text 574+ chars) — the previously-blank fix is confirmed
Sidebar links: AI Chat (/dashboard), Tasks, Reminders, Calendar, Team, Statistics, Image Analysis, WhatsApp, Profile — all render their main heading and content (no white screens)

Reminders page: 'Add Reminder' (data-testid=add-reminder-button) opens 'Create New Reminder' modal with Title / Date (calendar) / Time / Repeat selectors
Calendar page renders without errors (Calendar + 'Wed, Jun 3' heading)
Profile page renders: language switcher visible (English / العربية), Dark theme toggle, Thawani subscribe copy ('Pay with Thawani'/Subscribe present)
Admin panel (test-stripe@test.com): all 7 sidebar tabs visible — Overview, Users, Analytics, Billing, System, Audit Logs, Token Usage (+ Back to App)
Admin Users: 4 plan filter buttons (data-testid filter-plan-all/free/pro/business) — all clickable, filter works

Admin Users: clicking a user row reveals 'Change Subscription' button (data-testid=admin-change-subscription-button). Modal opens with Plan (Free/Pro/Business), Billing Cycle (Monthly/Yearly), Custom Duration field, Cancel + Apply Change buttons
Admin Audit Logs: data-testid=admin-audit-page + audit-table render with 3 entries; subscription_change rows show 'Pro→Free' / 'Free→Pro (yearly)' with target user email (demo@test.com)
No JS PageErrors during any flow. Only expected 401 on /api/auth/me before login and 403 on /api/email/config for non-admin demo user

rca of the issue: The previously reported 'blank Statistics page' was a ReferenceError caused by Statistics.js using useLanguage() without importing it. Main agent's fix (added `import { useLanguage } from '../context/LanguageContext';` on line 3) is correct and verified. Statistics page now renders fully with stat cards, weekly activity chart and quick stats. No regression detected across other dashboard or admin pages.
